task: Original Archer facial simplification: ranged and magic only
method: Built-in image_gen only. No API/CLI and no image postprocessing.

finals.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a 1536×1024 sheet of the same bearded crossbowman in ivory and charcoal costumes. Image 2 is REFERENCE ONLY: the original archival King Down Archer. The Archer supplies ONLY the degree of facial simplification.

Revise ONLY the two human faces in image 1, including simplification of the beard's internal shading. Match the original Archer's readable angular sculptural painted facial planes: a deep connected brow/eye-socket shadow with narrow implied eyes and no visible iris or eye-white detail, a simple straight wedge nose, restrained small shaped mouth, and faceted cheek and jaw planes. Keep this crossbowman's adult broad male head and strong beard: simplify beard detail into a few larger painted masses without changing its outline. Preserve his individual proportions and identity. The result still has a fully modeled adult face, not a blank face or cartoon facial glyphs.

Keep ALL non-face content and overall painted illustrated style as close to image 1 as possible: both hats and helmet straps, hair outlines, beard silhouette, neck/collars, armor, clothing, hands, full crossbows, bolts, legs and feet; the exact poses and head angles, positions and sizes; left ivory and right charcoal palettes. Do not copy the Archer's hood, hair, costume, head proportions, or 3D-looking body rendering. Avoid big bright eyes, detailed irises, eyelashes, realistic skin pores, small wrinkles, dot/dash glyph eyes, a faceless mask, anime, cute doll faces, or realistic portrait detail.

Composition must stay 1536×1024 landscape with both COMPLETE figures at the original scale and foot baseline. Preserve the original generous top/bottom/outer margins and gap. No enlargement, repositioning, clipping of either crossbow, or crop. Background must be genuinely transparent, no painted backdrop, no gradient, no glow, no checkerboard. No new objects or text.
finals.qa: Pass: angular broad face planes, deep contiguous socket shadows without detailed whites/irises, beard simplified into masses, male identity preserved; full crossbows/bolts/hats/feet intact. 1536x1024 RGBA, alpha range 0-254, 1,016,557 fully transparent pixels. Modest generated scale drift: top hat y~49 versus original ~80; feet y~973 versus ~949. No clipping; original framing not pixel-exact.
